name: strike-screen-protocol

change_log.1: ADR-0270 preregistered procedure, written for the CDFHyperparameterStudy path.
change_log.2: Execution-path revision (before any fit): the screen's fits are CDFExperiment queues (run-strike-screen-fits-L1/L3.json), the arms study document is the panel source only. (1) sharing states what the queue does: one output head per ticker. (2) the chain input is the representation the panel emits, pinned by name in appendix.chain_columns; the logit-CDF vector is deferred. (3) verification gains the recoverability script, the block-shift control document and their place before any fit of the screen. (4) caps separate the stores (own ceiling, larger per-file limit) from fit outputs. (5) cal_n is 82, the value of its own derivation (was 74). (6) fit-band scores are a deterministic stride sample; liquidity tercile groups are deferred to registration. (7) fold_tables.notes describes the queue, with no selection stage. (8) weight_decay range unified to [0.01, 0.3]; head width 8 declared. (9) the recoverability gates are magnitudes (D <= 0.02, max reliability gap <= 0.02, CRPS within 5%) with KS p-values information only; the block-shift control is the L1 document on the shifted panel (8 cells) with a stop rule of paired weighted_crps skill above 0.5% on either fold.
change_log.3: Before any fit of the screen. (1) Sequence disclosure: the owner instructed the replacement of the PIT KS p-value gate by magnitude gates before the first recoverability run, but the change was committed after that run (75b1c81b); the run's result is kept as stage0/recoverability-superseded-gate-change.json (superseded) and the check is re-run fresh under these committed gates. (2) The synthetic recoverability check is Stage 0 (synthetic data, no real-data fit); approval B covers real-data fits only. (3) A third write class, evidence tables (rows.parquet, cells.parquet of StrikeRegionScores), with a 2 GiB per-file limit and its own 4 GB ceiling, excluded from the 1 GB new-output cap; the 64 MiB limit is for fit logs, JSON, checkpoints and score shards. (4) The no-information arm and the power harness are merged into the two executable checks: the block-shift control IS the null and the synthetic recoverability IS the power harness. (5) market_calibrated: the promising-cell rule is split into a provisional screen rule (market_raw and the empirical references) and a final rule that adds market_calibrated once the market stage lands. (6) strike-screen-experiment-template.json and strike-screen-matrix.json are SUPERSEDED by the run-strike-screen-fits-* documents. (7) Recoverability settings pinned; screen_fits text corrected to 16 cells and the attempt inventory added; weight_decay 0.01 is the screen value, [0.01, 0.3] the promotion axis; the wall rule min(ceiling, remaining budget) is stated in caps; the block-shift null's approximations and the skill formula are stated; the read-guard note for readers that bound after load is added. (8) After the lens on 53fd50e8, before any fit: the holdout statement is the exact one in windows.holdout.read_guard (it no longer claims the holdout is unread: Arrow may decode the date column of a straddling row group during the converter step); the recoverability settings and gates are machine-readable and the script reads them from this file; the size tiers are restated as measured totals only. (9) After the lens on ceb0a330: the recoverability script resolves the protocol from a --worktree argument and refuses any worktree whose protocol sha256 differs from the one pinned in the inventory (there is no --protocol flag); the timing verdict honours the recoverability result only for that pinned sha; skipped L1 cells do not block L3; unexpected errors in the verdict script exit 3; the seal statement is scoped to the revision-3 runbook.
change_log.4: Before any fit of the screen is scored. The queue found that the per-name empirical baseline had no rule for a validation horizon its fit band never saw (HorizonEmpiricalCDF refuses an unseen key by contract). Rule: the empirical baseline of a validation row whose exact horizon has no fit rows in the same name's fit band uses the nearest fitted horizon (ties to the shorter), counted per shard (baseline_unseen_horizon_rows, baseline_unseen_horizon_max_distance); the model's curve is unaffected. Measured on the panel: fold 1 348 of 172,612 validation rows, fold 2 33 of 712,713; the nearest fitted horizon is 1 day away at the median, at most 3. Nothing else in the protocol changes.

notes: ADR-0270 preregistered training/validation PROCEDURE for the strike screen (revision 4, see change_log). Pure data: the executable documents (strike-screen-panel-source.json, run-strike-screen-fits-L1/L3/timing/control.json, run-strike-region-scores*.json) must pin every value here, enforced by children/index_options/tests. Predictability only: proper scores and calibration; nothing about trading. Every number below is fixed BEFORE any outcome of the validation window is read; a change is a new revision of this file with its own identity hash and ADR line.

formulation.row: (symbol, quote_date, expiry) for every listed expiry with 1 <= dte <= max_dte

inputs.context: calendar_dte, sessions_to_expiry, log_calendar_dte, log_sessions_to_expiry, calendar_days_per_session, reference_scale, rv_1, rv_5, rv_22, rv_66, down_rv_5, down_rv_22, up_rv_5, up_rv_22, momentum_5, momentum_22, vl_log_volume_ratio_66, vl_log_volume_ratio, vl_log_dollar_volume, vl_amihud
inputs.chain: the available representation, emitted by ExactExpiryCDFPanel: the 19 risk-neutral quantiles rn_q_* in z units, the rn_* shape scalars and the surface scalars and dynamics (118 columns, named in appendix.chain_columns); the logit F_Q(z_k) - logit Phi(z_k) vector at the 13 grid points and the contract-set tensor are deferred (they need a panel feature owner)

cohort.rule: price panel ∩ Theta complete through 2020 minus alarmed roots
cohort.basis: split-adjusted closes; chain strikes/underlying rescaled per symbol-day to that basis by the converter

development.note: 2016 dropped: 79 of 118 names have no valid quote before 2017-01-03

monitor_band.rule: last cal_n distinct origins of the fit window, labels purged at the band start

holdout.status: SEALED; fit documents carry holdout_start 2024-01-01; opened once for promoted recipes trained through 2023
holdout.read_guard: within the revision-3 runbook, rows at or after 2024-01-01 are never returned, emitted, written or used. Arrow predicate evaluation may decode the date column of a straddling row group in the frozen export during the converter step (the only step whose inputs contain holdout rows; every later input is bounded at 2024-01-01 by the converter); row-group pruning by footer statistics is a recorded gap. Defense in depth: the raw-chain prepare, the panel and the archive readers bound rows after loading a file's row groups, not by pushdown, and rely on the converter's output holding no row at or after 2024-01-01; the fit-queue and scoring readers push the bound into the scan (DateBoundedParquet)

windows.purge: a label whose settlement >= the next window start is dropped (label_reaches); no row of one window informs another

fold_tables.notes: The screen runs as CDFExperiment queues (run-strike-screen-fits-*.json): every fold of the table is fitted for every cell and there is no selection stage; the warm-up fold (2019 validation origins, inside development) is a fitted cell like the scored fold. Ranking happens in the analysis step by the preregistered rule; cells of interest and any promotion rule are recorded in the next revision of this file AFTER the validation screen and BEFORE any promotion refit or holdout read. Each fold's monitor band is the last cal_n origins of its own train window.

early_stopping.monitor: composite training loss on the monitor band
early_stopping.ceiling_hit: recorded skip, consumed, flagged for the rung audit, never retried

training.capacity: max_parameters = min(100000, 0.25 * fit rows); refusals are results
training.sharing: pooled regime of CDFExperiment: shared encoder/trunk with one output head per ticker (118 heads, ~9.6k parameters); a single shared head is a promotion-rung axis, not available in the screen

size_tiers.S1_mlp: measured pooled totals with the 118 heads: 11,118 parameters (price_only) and 12,070 (price_plus_chain)
size_tiers.S3_patchtst32_control: deliberate over-capacity control; measured pooled totals with the 118 heads: 18,686 parameters (price_only) and 19,638 (price_plus_chain)

training.monitor_band_sensitivity: cal_n 82 in the screen; cal_n 126 as a promotion-rung sensitivity (R5 fold 2 best epoch 1 with a 40-origin single-regime band)

verification_before_any_ranking.synthetic_recoverability: Stage 0 (synthetic data, no real-data fit). Simulate z from a known conditional 2-component mixture driven by two features (pilot-root script prepare/synthetic_recoverability.py; settings pinned, machine-readable in synthetic_recoverability_settings, which the script reads from this file and which it refuses to override: 24 synthetic tickers, seed 2027, 17,880 validation rows, the L1 document's price_only arm and mlp candidate, cpu, epochs 30, patience 5, learning rate 0.003 (synthetic scale, fixed budget; the document's is 0.0003), per_row 1000, head_per_row 1000): the REAL CDFExperiment and StrikeRegionScores must pass three magnitude gates on the validation band: CRPS within 5% of the oracle mixture's CRPS, PIT Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic D <= 0.02, and the largest |reliability gap| (mean F(z) against the realized frequency of y <= z) over the 13 grid thresholds <= 0.02. The oracle's own D and the KS p-values are information only (with thousands of rows a p-value tests sample size, not usefulness); writes stage0/recoverability.json with pass or fail per gate
verification_before_any_ranking.learning_curves: train vs monitor loss per epoch for every fit; 'best epoch 1' = no learning, reported
verification_before_any_ranking.train_and_validation_scores: every score below computed on fit rows AND validation rows; a validation gain without a training gain is a flag
verification_before_any_ranking.overfit_signature: train score improves while monitor/validation worsens after the best epoch
order: strike Brier vs market/empirical/pooled with clustered intervals
verification_before_any_ranking.block_shift_label_control: prepare/make_block_shift_panel.py copies the materialized panel with terminal_return shifted by 120 sessions within each symbol (labels misaligned, features intact); run-strike-screen-fits-control.json is the L1 document (epochs 120, patience 10, both folds, 8 cells: a real arm's budget) on that panel; the expected outcome is no skill versus horizon_empirical; skill = 1 - mean(model_weighted_crps) / mean(baseline_weighted_crps), paired on the control shards per fold; a skill above 0.5% on either fold means leakage: halt before L1 and L3. Approximations of this null: regime persistence (a 120-session shift keeps volatility regimes partly aligned, so a small positive skill can be real), the purge on its own settlement (the bands purge on each row's own settlement date, not on the shifted label's), and the 0.5% threshold is uncalibrated (no null distribution of the skill has been simulated).
verification_before_any_ranking.null_and_power: The earlier plan's no-information arm and power harness are merged into the two executable checks. The block-shift control IS the null: labels are misaligned, so any skill is leakage. The synthetic recoverability IS the power harness: a known effect is recovered within 5% of the oracle. An arm without a return sequence is not expressible: TorchCDF's external encoder requires a return sequence.
verification_before_any_ranking.l1_skips_and_l3: A skipped L1 cell (an epoch-ceiling skip, a capacity refusal) is a recorded outcome: the queue exits 0, the skip is reported with the results, and it does not block L3, whose cells are independent fits. A failed, timed-out or stopped L1 queue (a non-zero exit) blocks L3, and so does a halted or incomplete stop-rule verdict

local: decision_strike_brier at the row's listed strikes
region_mass vs realized for the 14 regions
scores.horizon_empirical_unseen_horizon: Revision 4: The empirical baseline of a validation row whose exact horizon has no fit rows in the same name's fit band uses the nearest fitted horizon (ties to the shorter), counted per shard (baseline_unseen_horizon_rows, baseline_unseen_horizon_max_distance); the model's curve is unaffected.
scores.reporting: full window with clustered interval, then each validation year and each sub-period; no sub-period selection

fit_band.rule: a deterministic stride sample of the fit band per cell (the whole validation band is always scored); named by band_sampled and band_rows_population in rows.parquet

cells.strike_regions: 12 inner 0.5-wide z bins plus two tails

ticker_groups.secondary: fit-band liquidity tercile; later per ticker as descriptive only. The terciles of the 118 names are computed at registration from the fit band (cohorts.json holds terciles for the 24 market names only); until then ticker_groups is empty and the secondary family is deferred

per_cell: paired differences with symbol- and date-clustered intervals

promising_cell_rule.provisional: the screen rule, evaluated on what StrikeRegionScores produces (market_raw and the empirical references): paired region-Brier improvement vs market_raw AND vs the empirical reference with interval excluding zero, support >= 30 events, >= 20 expiries, >= 20 symbols per year, same sign in >= 3 of 4 validation years; Holm within the primary family; never the best cell by score
promising_cell_rule.final: the provisional rule with market_calibrated added (improvement vs market_calibrated as well), evaluated only when the market stage lands: its own registration, windows 2017-2023, the admitted groups G1/G2 unblocked; market_calibrated is joined to the cells by identity
promising_cell_rule.status: cells pass to promotion as provisional until the final rule has been evaluated

cells.decision_point: cells of interest and any rule are written to this file's next revision AFTER the validation screen and BEFORE any promotion refit or holdout read

arms.price_plus_chain: price_only + own_iv + the 118 chain columns of appendix.chain_columns (the contract set and the logit-CDF vector are deferred)

arms_and_candidates.screen_fits: 2 arms x 2 encoders x 2 losses x 2 folds = 16 cells (8 per loss document); 4 timing cells and 8 control cells are charged beside them
arms_and_candidates.promotion: top 2 recipes + {price_only mlp L1} audit, 4 refits x 3 seeds each
arms_and_candidates.weighting_guard: L3 rejected if global crps > 0.5% relative worse than same-arm L1
arms_and_candidates.eligibility: paired crps skill vs horizon_empirical > 0 on validation
arms_and_candidates.research_basis: docs/research/distribution-modeling/2026-10-18-model-architecture-size-testing.md: encoder is a secondary axis (12 architectures within ±0.2% on price features); chain branch, loss and size carry the screen

caps.new_output_scope: new fit, control and scoring-summary outputs under the pilot root, excluding the stores (onboarding store, converter output, raw-chain prepare, panel cache and control panel) and the evidence tables, polled with du between steps; observational, not a quota

evidence_tables.ceiling_status: declared; measured after the first scoring document
evidence_tables.synthetic_evidence: 957 B/row (rows.parquet of the synthetic recoverability run: 19,799 rows, 232 columns, 18.9 MB)
evidence_tables.real_size_estimate: unmeasured; at 957 B/row each million rows is about 0.96 GB, and the real row count (the whole validation band plus a 25,000-row fit-band sample per cell) is a Stage 0 count

caps.wall_rule: a step's timeout is min(ceiling, remaining packet wall budget): min(ceiling, remaining) is the rule, so the ceilings' sum may exceed wall_seconds_total and the cap still holds

pins_to_fill_before_launch: converter outputs (surface, lifecycle, archive, closes, own_iv) manifest sha256

appendix.notes: names the chain columns of the price_plus_chain arm, in panel order (features[43:161] of the fit documents); a test pins the arms to this list

inventory.empirical_refits: one horizon_empirical per (cell, fold, symbol); counted at registration from G1 and G2
